title: Existence of Quantum Crystals
exact_target: Prove that a suitable neutral quantum system develops a periodic crystal structure as its size tends to infinity.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 7900013 (AMR-078-0013). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Barry Simon, Schrödinger operators in the twenty-first century, Mathematical Physics 2000, pp. 283–288, original Problem 13.
Wikipedia contributors, Simon problems, pinned revision 1335881350, The 2000 list. Existing catalogue wording adapted; CC BY-SA 4.0.

status_qualification: The existential word some is preserved. The catalogue leaves the system, treatment of nuclei and topology of the periodic limit unspecified; a statement for every material or a prescribed lattice would be stronger.
